landmarks.name: Siltstrand Roads
landmarks.note: A band of rounded cobbles well above the waterline, from a sea that has since dropped.

landmarks.name: Wrackholm Roads
landmarks.note: An old shoreline stranded above the present one, level enough to build a road on.

landmarks.name: Lagoonlow Stack
landmarks.note: A heap of coral sand built up on the reef flat, moved by every serious storm.

landmarks.name: Holm below Tidalstrand
landmarks.note: A bare rock the sea covers and uncovers; a hazard, never a landing.
